messages:
maya (Solutions): Quick sync — OrionCloud pilot kicks off Mon. They want SSO (SAML), predictable routing for EU traffic, and a ballpark monthly cost for a shared co-sell tenant. Can we confirm blockers and owners?
jess (OrionCloud Partner): Thanks Maya. We also need the security questionnaire answered by Wed. Our legal wants certs and data residency notes.
raj (Sales Eng): I can handle pricing estimate. Need expected QPS and retention. jess — what volumes are you expecting?
jess (OrionCloud Partner): Starting small: ~500 reqs/min peak, ~10k req/day. p90 latency target ~200ms. Will scale after pilot.
raj (Sales Eng): Ok — rough config: Dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) with autoscale to 4 for bursts + prefix KV caching. Back-of-envelope monthly ~8k–12k depending on GPU time and egress. Can refine after we know exact sequence lengths.
tom (Infra): For EU routing we can pin to eu-west-1 nodes. Two asks: (1) do we need fixed egress IPs for their firewall? (2) SSO SAML metadata to pre-provision.
jess (OrionCloud Partner): Yes to fixed IPs. I'll need a list to send to our netsec. For SAML, I'll share our IdP metadata later today.
katie (Security): Also need pen-test certs and encryption at rest details. Is customer data stored on dedicated volumes for this pilot?
maya (Solutions): For co-sell pilot we'll use a shared tenant but with tenant-level isolation (dedicated volumes per tenant). Policy: data at rest AES-256, TLS1.2+ in transit. I'll attach our cert statement to the questionnaire.
raj (Sales Eng): Jess — can you confirm whether logs need to be forwarded to OrionCloud SIEM? That affects egress and cost.
jess (OrionCloud Partner): Not in pilot, but plan for eventual forwarding. For now only basic audit logs via the Console.
tom (Infra): Egress IPs (provisional):
```
34.210.45.12/32
34.210.45.13/32
34.210.45.14/32
```
These are NAT IPs for the EU sandbox pool; I'll confirm once we provision the dedicated tenant.
katie (Security): Thanks — please also provide cert expiry dates and contact for incident response.
maya (Solutions): Action items: (1) Tom to confirm final egress IPs & provisioning ETA. (2) Jess to send IdP metadata + completed security questionnaire. (3) Raj to send a refined quote by EOD after we confirm sequence length.
sandbox-bot: sandbox-provisioner: sandbox created -> https://sandbox.redwood-inference.com/pilot/orioncloud-2145567890 (creds DM'd to jess & maya) :white_check_mark:
raj (Sales Eng): Will run a quick token cost calc — can someone post typical prompt/response token counts? 1 prompt ~120 tokens, response ~300 tokens assumed?
jess (OrionCloud Partner): That's reasonable for our demo prompts.
maya (Solutions): One blocker legal flagged: export control note for certain model weights in EU region — we need to confirm model variant. I'll sync with Applied ML.
tom (Infra): ETA for dedicated sandbox nodes: ~36 hrs once I get final headcount/tenant flag.
katie (Security): I'll start filling the questionnaire with what we have and tag legal for the export control line.
jess (OrionCloud Partner): Great — ping me when questionnaire is updated and when egress IPs are final so we can request firewall allowlist.
maya (Solutions): Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short runbook for the pilot (canary steps + rollback) before EOD. :thumbsup:
